publication.head: codex/5610-coverage-path-normalization
publication.title: [v0.91.8][CI][coverage] Normalize safe in-repo coverage paths
publication.body:
Closes #5610

Normalizes slash-unified llvm-cov filenames with platform-independent POSIX lexical semantics before owned-source matching. Safe in-root `bin/..` paths canonicalize, while repository-prefix and owned-root traversal escapes fail closed. When lexical aliases identify one canonical file, the merger requires matching metric schemas and non-summary fields, conservatively retains each metric's maximum count and covered values without summing, and recomputes percent and notcovered.

Focused FastWork proof passed: synthetic positive and negative regressions, exact replay of hosted run 29813137619 artifacts, Python compilation, coupled CI-runtime contracts, authoritative coverage-lane contracts, and diff hygiene. Exact scoped review found no findings. Summary-only coalescing is explicitly conservative because producer summaries do not retain covered-set identity.

Issue #5602 terminal truth remains immutable; consumer PR #5607 and PR #5608 branches are untouched.
